messages.author: 4f9701b3dc2dae8c
messages.subject: geom_smooth and legend colour
parts:
Hi,

When I use geom_line on a factor it sets the colour of the legend to
black, which is good because it differentiates between it and the
colours in the plots, but with geom_smooth it's blue, which is
visually confusing. Is there a way to change the legend colour for
geom_smooth, without changing the colour of the curves?

Thanks,
Gad


library(ggplot2)
d <- data.frame(x=rnorm(100), y=rnorm(100), foo=sample(c("A", "B",
"C"), 100, TRUE), bar=sample(c("X", "Y", "Z"), 100, TRUE))

ggplot(d, aes(x=x, y=y, colour=foo, linetype=bar)) + geom_line() # XYZ
in legend is in black
ggplot(d, aes(x=x, y=y, colour=foo, linetype=bar)) + geom_smooth() #
XYZ in legend is in blue

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: geom_smooth and legend colour
parts:
Hi

this is probably because the default colour of geom_smooth is blue.

so, try this:

GeomSmooth$default_aes <- function(.) aes(colour="black",
fill="grey60", size=0.5, linetype=1, weight=1, alpha=0.4)
ggplot(d, aes(x=x, y=y, colour=foo, linetype=bar)) + geom_smooth()

maybe there is more correct way, though.

--

messages.subject: Re: geom_smooth and legend colour
parts:
Try this trick,

GeomSmooth <- ggplot2:::GeomSmooth

GeomSmooth$default_aes <- function (.)
aes(colour = "red", fill = "blue", size = 0.5, linetype = 1,
weight = 1, alpha = 1)

environment(GeomSmooth) <- environment(ggplot2:::GeomSmooth)
assignInNamespace("GeomSmooth", GeomSmooth, ns="ggplot2")

b.
